'''Mission Quests''' ---- ''For regular quests, see [[Quests]], while for challenge maps, see [[Challenge Maps]].'' '''Mission Quests''' are a collection of objectives that can be completed by a player in-game. They can be found in the ''Quests'' menu under the ''Missions'' tab. Upon completing all objectives, players are granted rewards, which can range from {{Exp|}}, [[Towers|towers]] and skins, some exclusive to '''Mission Quests'''.
__TOC__ ==Mechanics== [[File:MissionQuestsV2.0.png|thumb]] '''Mission Quests''' require {{Coins|Coins}} to be able to start the contract. Additionally, '''Mission Quests''' cannot be started if the player does not own the associated tower. If a skin is already owned, contracts are marked as completed. Contracts can also be skipped, granting the rewards though at a price. Contracts cannot be skipped if the player is on the last objective. Upon accepting a contract, it will not expire in the majority of cases. Certain '''Mission Quests''' did expire after a while, though this was due to them containing objectives only possible in events, making them impossible to complete after the event required has ended.
